section_summary.extract_value: Abstract of a journal article reporting a path-analysis study with 249 college women testing a model in which body appreciation mediates between interpersonal/intrapersonal predictors (caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, perfectionism) and outcomes (intuitive eating, depressive symptoms). Findings: restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, and discrepancy perfectionism negatively predicted body appreciation, order perfectionism positively predicted it, and body appreciation predicted intuitive eating but not depressive symptoms. The abstract provides no country, age, race/ethnicity, BMI data, measurement instruments (BAS/BAS-2), or survey method details.
